findings.quote: That nod meant his father understood. That he had given [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO] the hill on one condition, and [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO] had kept it.
findings.claim: The nod already works. The paragraph tells the reader what to feel and ends by translating a wordless thing into words.

findings.quote: and left his plate there like a promise: we are waiting. You still have a place.
findings.claim: The mother says it, the narrator explains it at length, and the colon spells it out a third time.

findings.quote: looking out into the dark, looking toward the hill and the invisible path beyond
put a hand on his shoulder, and [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO] could feel that his hand was shaking
findings.claim: hand twice in a short sentence and the second is ambiguous as to whose it is

iterations.notes: 2 major, 2 minor; check_prose clean. The critic weighed whether three repetitions of I kept the rule were the book insisting or a frightened child insisting, and judged them the child. It did not flag them.

all four resolved and no new defect. The critic checked three seams the patches risked - the nod now running straight into Bruno s paragraph, the boy s speech carrying more in one breath, and whether the new last line lands or is cut off - and cleared all three. It noted the long speech is at the edge of what a ten-year-old says in one breath but marked that LATE, since it was equally true of the draft it had already scored.
